summary: Temporary escorted badge + sit-stand frame install in Building E Bay 3; secure return and courier of decommissioned GPU (chain-of-custody)
description:
Issue summary:
A one-time onsite contractor (Aegis Installations) required: 1) temporary escorted badge for a 3-hour window to assemble and bolt a sit-stand frame at workstation Bay 3-14 in Building E, 2) a licensed electrician to verify a dedicated outlet and install a cable management anchor, and 3) coordination to hand off a decommissioned GPU (Asset ID: GPU-98123) to secure courier for return to central decomm.

Impact:
- Delays in desk setup blocking new hire provisioning if not completed by EOD 2026-03-13.
- GPU contains customer logs and an encrypted SSD that must follow chain-of-custody and Data Disposal SOP.

Location / Environment:
- Building E, Floor 3, Bays 3-14 (near freight elevator). Onsite window requested 18:00-21:00 to avoid network lab hours.

Steps to complete (requested):
1) Facilities to confirm electrician slot and reserve freight elevator (18:00-19:00 preferred for heavy lifting).
2) Security to issue temporary escorted badge with door permissions: Bay-3, Workshop-Entrance, Freight-Elevator, valid only for 2026-03-13 18:00-21:00 and enforce escort by Marcus Bell.
3) Inventory to prep chain-of-custody form and affix tamper-evident seal to GPU crate.
4) Logistics to print pre-paid courier airway bill with secure handling instructions and schedule overnight pickup to vendor partner (Redwood Logistics).
5) On completion, update asset record GPU-98123 status -> "In transit - secure courier" and attach signed handoff scan to ticket.

Attachments referenced: freight-elevator-schedule.pdf, GPU-98123-asset-tag-photo.jpg, chain_of_custody_template_v3.pdf
investigation_notes: Checked access-control logs for previous temporary badges — policy requires escort for vendor accounts without payroll IDs. Freight elevator booking possible after 17:30, but concierge needs 24h notice for freight hours. Electrician (contracted via Facilities Partner: Kestrel Elec) confirmed a 30-min slot to install outlet anchor; will bring GFCI-rated outlet extension as backup. Inventory flagged GPU-98123 as containing encrypted SSD; disposal coordinator (Rohit Kapoor) confirmed courier needs signature + CCTV capture during handoff.
comments: 2026-03-13 09:12 - Aria Chen: Raised ticket after vendor confirmed availability for tonight. Need badge only for 3 hours. Also must ensure GPU is handed to secure courier; contains customer logs (encrypted).

2026-03-13 10:05 - Marcus Bell (Facilities): Ok, reserving freight elevator 18:00-18:30. Scheduling Kestrel Elec for 18:15. I will escort vendor. Will coordinate with security for temp badge generation.

2026-03-13 11:20 - Leila Grant (Security): Temporary escorted badge pre-created; requires Marcus to badge-in at Security desk to activate. Permissions limited to Bay-3, Workshop-Entrance, Freight-Elevator. Badge auto-expires 21:00. Escort required per policy. Noted that CCTV recording must capture handoff for chain-of-custody.

2026-03-13 15:40 - Rohit Kapoor (Inventory): Chain-of-custody form filled and tamper-evident seal packs ready. GPU-98123 box photographed and logged. Awaiting Logistics confirmation for AWB and pickup window.

2026-03-13 16:10 - Logistics (Automated): Pickup scheduled with Redwood Logistics - manifest #RL-77421, pickup window 19:30-20:30 from Loading Dock B. Carrier requires receipt signed by Facilities staff and will return POD scan to ticket email alias.

2026-03-13 19:05 - Marcus Bell: Onsite. Kestrel Elec installed outlet anchor and cable manager at 18:25. Vendor completed frame assembly at 19:10. GPU sealed and handed to courier at 19:42. Signed POD attached. Escorting vendor offsite now.

2026-03-14 08:02 - Rohit Kapoor: POD received from carrier (RL-77421) at 2026-03-13 20:48. Asset status updated to 'In transit - secure courier'. Imaging and disposal team notified to expect arrival at central decomm on 2026-03-15.
2026-03-14 12:33 - Leila Grant (Security): Verified CCTV clip of handoff captured and stored in Secure Evidence bucket (link added to Confluence page). Temporary badge auto-expired as scheduled.
2026-03-14 14:00 - Marcus Bell: Follow-up: Vendor left on time, no damage reported. Marking ticket resolved. Please reopen if any discrepancies on arrival at decomm.
resolution: Completed - Sit-stand frame installed by vendor under escort. Electrician validated outlet. Temporary escorted badge issued and auto-expired. GPU-98123 sealed and handed to Redwood Logistics (manifest RL-77421). Chain-of-custody PDF and POD attached. Follow-up action: Inventory to confirm receipt at decomm and then set asset record to 'Disposed' per SOP.
